scenario: 今天基础设施赛道保留已经发布的前缀缓存崩溃、推测解码与专家缓存等工作，并补上新露出来的几篇。它们涉及大规模 embedding 的快速聚类，用残差补偿换回 FP4 精度，低比特 KV cache 的仿射折叠解码，以及按偏差分布重算以复用跨请求缓存的系统。

papers.title: Inside the Trap: A Renewal Law for Prefix-Cache Collapse in LLM Agent Serving
papers.abstract: Prefix caching lets an LLM agent's follow-up turns reuse cached KV, but a burst can tip an engine into a trap in which every turn misses and the backlog does not drain, at a load it served before. In registered paired tests on two engines, two GPUs and two models (passed at 9 of 10 rates), a 200-session burst left the engine at zero hits to the end in all 30 runs, while every matched no-burst run stayed good and a session cap prevented the trap in all 30 capped runs. We analyse an idealization of the trapped state exactly: for a fluid FIFO server on which every turn misses, we prove that along FIFO orbits its cycles obey a linear renewal recursion. As is classical, the trap drains if and only if arrivals are below the all-miss capacity; above it, a Perron root fixes the dynamics: every trapped state converges to a known self-similar regime in which the gap between turns grows linearly and the turns served are young and short. For our workload the backlog grows at 0.6 to 0.8 of the excess load and sessions complete faster than the all-miss capacity, a youth premium with turn-count and cost-growth factors, so in the model a trap's measured throughput overstates the recovery threshold. Retrospectively, with nothing fitted to trap data, the theory matches 57 stuck runs: the mean served prompt within 3% in 50 runs, completions above the all-miss capacity in every run, and the pooled gap growth. Blind in outcome, 4 runs trapped by a tool slowdown met 4 of 5 pre-set scores, cut traps persisted, and with a 20-step budget, trapped runs completed below the all-miss capacity, as predicted. Of two exits, refusing arrivals sheds sessions; a session cap restores reuse: in registered tests it rescued 9 of 9 established traps at the same load without shedding, and the engine stayed good after release. We do not prove that the engine converges to the model.
papers.summary: LLM agent 的多轮对话靠前缀缓存省掉重复计算，但这篇论文发现一个陷阱：突然涌进一大批会话后，引擎可能掉进每一轮都不命中缓存的状态，积压再也消化不掉，哪怕这个负载它以前扛得住。作者在两种推理引擎、两种 GPU、两个模型上做了配对测试，200 个会话的突发让 30 次运行全部卡死到结束，没有突发的对照运行则都正常。作者把卡死状态抽象成每轮都不命中的排队模型，算出积压怎样增长。出路也简单：限制同时在跑的会话数，就能在同样负载下把已经卡死的引擎救回来。做 agent 服务，不能只看平均负载，还要防突发把缓存冲垮。

deep_reading.title: Inside the Trap: A Renewal Law for Prefix-Cache Collapse in LLM Agent Serving

papers.title: e-means: outperforming k-means (in one-tenth the epochs)
papers.authors: Swann Bessa, Pierre-Emmanuel Mazaré, Gergely Szilvasy, Hugo Touvron, David Picard, Matthijs Douze, Hervé Jégou
papers.abstract: Lloyd's k-means algorithm is a long-running standard for clustering, with applications in data analysis, retrieval, quantization and data curation. In this paper, we introduce an exponential moving average optimization procedure for k-means with mini-batch updates, powered by modern deep learning machinery and new insights. We also establish scaling laws on how decay rate and batch size impact final performance. This gives us a formulaic rule to fix them for multiple problem sizes and embedding datasets, without the need for any hyperparameter sweep. The resulting clustering algorithm, coined e-means, is much faster than Lloyd k-means and converges to lower losses, frequently even beating k-means++. On a wide array of embeddings datasets, it beats the loss of Lloyd k-means at 25 epochs in 1.4 to 2.6 epochs, which translates to 10-45x GPU wall-clock speedups compared to state-of-the-art k-means implementations. As an example, e-means partitions DINO10B, a dataset of 10 billion DINO embe
papers.summary: 大规模 embedding 聚类仍然常用 Lloyd 的 k-means，但要跑很多轮，超参也不好定。这篇工作把它改成带指数滑动平均的小批量更新，并给出衰减率和批量大小随聚类数、数据量变化的公式，直接代入即可，从而不用再做超参搜索。在多种 embedding 数据上，它用大约两轮到三轮就达到标准 Lloyd 算法跑 25 轮的损失，GPU 墙钟比现有实现快 10 到 45 倍。作为例子，它在百亿规模的 DINO embedding 上划出上千万个簇，只花了很少几轮，损失已经低于 Lloyd 长时间训练的结果。

papers.title: ResServe: Accurate and Efficient FP4 LLM Inference with Residue Compensation
papers.authors: Shuo Rong, Ruibo Fan, Jiawen Wen, Xiaowen Chu
papers.abstract: Block-scaled 4-bit floating-point (FP4) quantization reduces large language model inference costs but can degrade task quality. Higher-precision computation can mitigate this loss at the expense of some of the efficiency gains from FP4 inference. Narrow matrix computations common in decoding often leave spare hardware capacity for low-cost precision recovery. ResServe combines an FP4 activation base with an FP4-quantized residue representing information lost during quantization. It uses this spare capacity to compute the residue's contribution and combines results on-chip, avoiding extra result transfers. We apply this principle to linear layers and decode attention, while selective compensation limits added work when processing input prompts. On NVIDIA B200, compensated linear kernels using the NVFP4 format improve numerical precision while retaining latency close to uncompensated execution for the evaluated operations with few rows. In the evaluated NVFP4 inference configurations, Re
papers.summary: 把大模型推理量化到四位浮点能省成本和时间，但任务质量往往会掉。解码时矩阵比较窄，硬件常常还有余量。这篇工作在 FP4 激活之外再保留一份同样量化过的残差，用来表示量化丢掉的信息，并利用这些余量在片上把残差贡献算完、加回去，避免额外把结果搬来搬去。在 NVIDIA B200 上，相对不补偿的四位权重和四位激活，请求延迟最多增加 3.4%。在五个模型上，相对同格式不补偿推理，代码生成准确率平均相对提高 15.04%。

papers.title: FOSCAR: Accelerating Decode Attention over 2- and 4-Bit KV Caches through Affine Folding
papers.authors: Donglin Zhuang, Pragaash Ponnusamy, Xiaoxia Wu, Shuaiwen Leon Song, Zhongzhu Zhou
papers.abstract: Large-language-model decode attention streams the key-value (KV) cache for every generated token. Packing that cache into 2-bit or 4-bit quantized integers reduces memory traffic but does not automatically translate into latency saving. Existing 2-bit fused kernels reach under 31%/15% of peak HBM throughput on H100/B200. Converting each value and applying its scale and offset before feeding Tensor Cores is a major bottleneck because instruction-issue throughput is scarce on modern GPUs. Instead of applying scale and offset to each KV value, FOSCAR uses affine folding to apply them to the other operand or the output of decode-attention matrix products, depending on the quantization scheme (token-wise or channel-wise). This reduces scale-and-offset operations by up to two orders of magnitude while preserving the dequantized attention output in exact arithmetic. FOSCAR also uses bit manipulation to feed KV operands to Tensor Cores efficiently, requiring only 1 and 0.19 ALU instructions pe
papers.summary: 解码注意力每生成一个 token 都要流式读取 KV cache。把它压成低比特整数能减少访存，但不自动等于更低延迟，因为先给每个值做反量化再送进 Tensor Core，会把现代 GPU 上本就紧张的指令发射打满。这篇工作不给 cache 里的每个值单独做缩放和偏置，而是用仿射折叠把这些运算作用到矩阵乘的另一个操作数或输出上，从而在精确算术意义下保持反量化后的注意力结果。在 H100 上，INT2 和 INT4 内核相对 FlashInfer 的 BF16，几何平均分别加快 3.36 倍和 2.83 倍。

papers.title: A Controlled Experimental Evaluation of Configuration and Cache Architecture in LLM Serving Engines
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM applications repeat most of their prompt tokens across requests, and serving engines reuse the cached state of shared prefixes. vLLM and SGLang reuse it at different granularities, and benchmarks of their default deployments report large performance gaps, usually credited to the cache. Such comparisons rarely control for other configuration differences. One of them, whether a long prompt is prefilled in chunks, is set by each engine's defaults from the hardware and the release, and it confounds the comparison. We built a reproducible testbed on Kubernetes and a seeded multi-agent workload generator, and compared the two engines under vendor defaults and with chunked prefill matched. SGLang's configuration is the same in both arms, which makes it an internal control across independently provisioned deployments. Under defaults, vLLM's median time to first token is up to 64x SGLang's. Matching one setting removes 78% of the capacity gap where that gap is largest and 30 to 67% of the latency gap. Near saturation the remaining latency gap reflects queue growth. A fluid queue model driven only by a 4.4% throughput shortfall reproduces it, and shows that such a gap scales with the length of the benchmark run. What survives matching is a tail-latency advantage of 2.4 to 6.4x at equal throughput, consistent with cache-aware ordering of waiting requests. We derive six recommendations for comparing serving engines.
papers.summary: 常有评测说 SGLang 比 vLLM 快很多，并把功劳归给它的前缀缓存设计。这篇论文发现，按默认配置做的对比里混进了另一个设置：长 prompt 要不要分块做 prefill。按默认配置跑多 agent 负载，vLLM 首 token 延迟的中位数最高是 SGLang 的 64 倍；只把分块 prefill 这一项对齐，两者能持续承受的吞吐之差，在差距最大的设置下就缩小了 78%，首 token 延迟的差距也随之明显缩小。对齐之后剩下的真实优势，是同等吞吐下 SGLang 的尾延迟更低，这和它按缓存情况给等待请求排序的做法相符。比较推理引擎时，要先把配置对齐，再谈缓存架构的高下。

papers.title: Accelerating Offloading-Based MoE Inference by Interleaving Concurrent Requests
papers.authors: Hongseung Yu, In Gim, Kyunghan Lee, Lin Zhong
papers.abstract: Expert offloading enables large mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models to run locally, but conventional batching stalls the GPU while missing experts are fetched. A popular remedy, known as prefetching, is to predict what experts will be needed soon and fetch them using idle link bandwidth. Imprecise prediction, however, wastes bandwidth and GPU memory on fetching unnecessary experts. Our key finding is that prefetching can be harmful when there is an expert cache in GPU memory. This is because as the cache includes more necessary experts, expert prediction becomes less precise. Our key insight is that proper request scheduling beats prefetching. Building on this insight, we present Bevy, an MoE inference system based on runahead inference for concurrent requests. A request whose experts are available can run ahead to later layers while other requests wait for fetches, revealing the experts it needs next. Bevy can then fetch the missing experts so identified while computing ready requests, overlapping computation and fetching without predicting expert selections. Running requests separately, however, repeats reads of shared weights in GPU memory and increases compute time. To limit this cost, Bevy's self-balancing scheduler batches ready requests at each layer and prioritizes lagging requests, adapting their grouping as expert availability changes. Across two local platforms, Bevy delivers up to 3.46$\times$ the decode throughput of 【11†this http URL†llama.cpp】 and up to 1.55$\times$ that of the fastest prefetching baseline.
papers.summary: 在本地跑大型 MoE 模型时，显存装不下全部专家，只能边算边从内存搬。常见的补救是预取，趁链路空闲提前搬来下一层可能要用的专家。作者发现，显存里有专家缓存时预取反而可能有害。缓存里已有的必需专家越多，剩下的就越难猜准，猜错的专家白白占用带宽和显存。Bevy 不猜，而是靠调度。它同时处理多个请求。专家已经到位的请求先继续往后算，从而确定后面层真正要调用的专家，搬运和计算就此重叠。在两种本地平台上，它的解码吞吐最高是最快预取方案的 1.55 倍。本地部署 MoE 时，排好请求的先后可能比预测专家更有用。

papers.title: ResQAdam: Residual-Preserving Adaptive Optimization for Memory-Efficient Quantization Aware Training
papers.authors: Liqun Ma, Shengkun Tang, Liangyu Wang, Lin Zhao, Wei Luo, Xinjun Niu, Spandan Tiwari, Ashish Sirasao, Kun Zhang, Zhiqiang Shen
papers.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is the most reliable way to obtain accurate low-bit large language models (LLMs), but training with AdamW keeps two dense FP32 states for every weight matrix. We find that low-rank memory-efficient optimizers such as GaLore and LDAdam degrade substantially in QAT. A considerable part of the QAT momentum lies outside its top-r singular subspace, and projection-based methods discard this part at every step. We further observe that this residual remains useful when only its sign is kept. Based on these observations, we propose ResQAdam. It keeps a single BF16 momentum, applies Adam only to the r x r coordinates of the principal subspace, and adds a normalized sign update computed from the residual. We evaluate ResQAdam with two from-scratch QAT methods and three QAT fine-tuning pipelines, with weights quantized down to 2 bits. It reduces optimizer-state memory by 71% to 74% relative to AdamW, stays close to AdamW in most settings, and lowers training throughput by less than 2%.
papers.summary: QAT 是得到低比特大模型最可靠的办法，但用 AdamW 训练时，每个权重矩阵都要多存两份 FP32 的优化器状态，非常占显存。GaLore 这类低秩优化器只保留动量的主要方向来省显存，作者发现它们在 QAT 里明显变差：动量有相当一部分落在主要方向之外，每一步都被扔掉了，而这部分哪怕只留下正负号也仍然有用。ResQAdam 因此只存一份 BF16 动量，在主要方向上照常做 Adam 更新，其余部分只取正负号，再把剩余方向上只保留正负号的更新，按整体幅度缩放到和主方向上的 Adam 更新一样长，然后加到同一组参数上。它比 AdamW 省下七成多的优化器显存，多数设置下精度接近 AdamW，训练吞吐只降不到 2%。

papers.title: DARIC: A Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse System with Distribution-Aware Recomputation
papers.authors: Weikang Wang, Haiyang Liu, Xin Zhou, Jun Liu, Weifeng Zhang
papers.abstract: The context lengths of large language models (LLMs) are rapidly increasing in real-world applications such as agentic systems and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). To accelerate LLM inference in these scenarios, reusing position-independent key-value (KV) caches across requests has emerged as a promising approach. This technique typically relies on recomputing a selected subset of tokens to restore cross-chunk interactions. However, existing solutions suffer from critical limitations in both algorithmic efficiency and system deployment. Algorithmically, they overlook the distribution of KV cache deviations, leading to either high token-selection overhead or degraded generation quality. At the system level, the reliance on custom LLM execution flows for recomputation complicates deployment and prevents seamless integration with highly optimized inference engines. In this paper, we propose DARIC (\textbf{D}istribution-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{R}ecomputation for \textbf{I}ndependent KV
papers.summary: 上下文变长之后，跨请求复用不必绑定原序列位置的 KV cache，能加快首个 token 的生成，但通常要再算一部分 token，才能恢复不同块之间的交互。现有做法不太看复用后的 KV 相对完整重算结果偏了多少，选 token 要么开销大，要么伤质量。作者先在多种模型和数据上统计复用缓存相对完整重算会偏到哪些位置，再按这些规律优先重算每块缓存开头的若干 token，越靠后的块重算得越多，总预算随独立缓存块数量增减，并始终重算提示末尾近期上下文；做成生成缓存和重算可以分开、接入现有引擎负担较小的架构。在智能体编程场景里，它的通过率和完整重算接近，同时把 TTFT 加快了 2.1 倍；在若干长上下文检索问答数据上，加速最高达到 8.2 倍。

papers.title: Extending LLDB to Debug Applications That Span CPUs and GPUs
papers.abstract:
We built a vendor-neutral accelerator plugin architecture in lldb-server for debugging applications that span CPUs and GPUs. It separates shared debugger infrastructure from hardware-specific device control. The design represents the CPU and GPU as separate debugger processes while presenting them in one debugging session. Modern AI applications rarely execute in one place. A workload can [...]

Read More...

The post Extending LLDB to Debug Applications That Span CPUs and GPUs appeared first on Engineering at Meta.
papers.summary: AI 程序经常在 CPU 代码和 GPU 内核之间来回切换，一个错误跨过这道边界时，开发者需要同时看清主机和设备两边的状态。过去 GPU 厂商各做各的调试器，比如 ROCgdb 和 CUDA-GDB，通用的调试功能要各自重复实现。Meta 在 LLDB 里做了一套不绑定厂商的加速器插件架构：把 CPU 和 GPU 当成两个独立的被调试进程，各自保留自己的指令集、寄存器和地址空间，再放进同一个调试会话里呈现。共享的调试功能只写一次，硬件相关的控制交给各厂商的插件，同一个地址在 CPU 和 GPU 上指向不同位置也不会混淆。写 GPU 内核和推理系统的工程师，有望用一个调试器跨两边定位问题。

papers.title: CodeQuant2: Enhanced Outlier Mitigation and Adaptive Clustering for Low-Precision LRMs
papers.authors: Xingyu Liu, Xiangyang Yin, Tianhua Xia, Haiyu Wang, Sai Qian Zhang
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve task performance by generating longer intermediate reasoning traces, but this substantially increases inference costs and makes low-precision quantization increasingly important. However, aggressively quantized models often perform poorly on reasoning tasks. We observe larger activation fluctuations during the first decoding steps of reasoning. Calibration that omits these early states may miss their activation fluctuations. To address these reasoning-specific quantization challenges, we propose \textbf{CodeQuant2}, a clustering-based LUT quantization framework for low-precision large reasoning models. CodeQuant2 mitigates activation outliers with rotation and scaling, uses clustering to represent non-uniform weight distributions, and adapts codebook sizes to the quantization difficulty of each layer. Guided by our observation of reasoning-time activation behavior, CodeQuant2 further improves calibration sample selection to better match actual decoding statistics. Combined with our customized LUT CUDA kernel, CodeQuant2 delivers substantial accuracy improvements on reasoning benchmarks while achieving up to $2.85\times$ speedup over BF16.
papers.summary: 推理模型靠写很长的思考过程提升效果，推理成本也随之上涨，低比特量化因此更重要，可量化得狠了，推理题的成绩往往掉得厉害。作者观察到，解码刚开始的几步里激活值波动特别大，而常规的校准数据没有覆盖这些早期状态。CodeQuant2 用旋转和缩放压住激活里的异常值，用聚类得到的查找表表示分布不均匀的权重，并专门挑选能覆盖解码刚开始那几步的校准样本。配上定制的 CUDA 内核，它明显提升了低比特推理模型在推理基准上的精度，速度最高是 BF16 的 2.85 倍。给推理模型做量化，校准数据要覆盖解码刚开始的那几步。

papers.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Kunjun Li, Wenhao Chai, Yihao Liang, Yuezhou Hu, Shuyao Xu, Yi Pan, William X. Zheng, Kannan Ramchandran, Kurt Keutzer, Jiantao Jiao
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46$\times$ to 10.87$\times$ with one request, and from 1.94$\times$ to 3.93$\times$ with batching.
papers.summary: 并行草稿模型一次前向就能草拟一整段 token，理论上能让投机解码加速很多，但它们官方发布的系统离这个上限还很远：单个请求时每步只接受少量 token，却要读一遍目标模型的全部权重；批处理时，每个请求的验证开销又把加速砍掉大约一半。SpecPilot 让一组 agent 针对具体部署自动找优化：成本模型先指出离上限最远的环节，多个 agent 并行尝试改系统实现或运行配置，每个输出 token 都和原系统逐一比对，防止为了提速改变结果。不训练、不损质量，单请求时相对自回归解码的加速从 4.46 倍提到 10.87 倍。投机解码的系统实现还有很大的空间。

papers.title: PagedMoE: Cross-Precision Expert Caching for Token-Level Dynamic Precision in SSD-Resident MoE Inference
papers.authors: Yutong Lin, Yingdi Shan, Shaoyuan Chen, Yuanyong Chen, Yongwei Wu, Mingxing Zhang
papers.abstract: Large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are promising for local inference because sparse routing allows the routed-expert pool to reside on SSD while DRAM caches recently used experts. However, under practical DRAM cache capacities, substantial SSD I/O remains on the critical path despite I/O-computation overlap. Token-level dynamic expert precision offers a natural way to reduce this data demand by allocating bits according to expert importance and quantization sensitivity. Nevertheless, treating each bit-width of the same expert as an independent object prevents cross-precision cache reuse, causing overlapping data to be fetched repeatedly. > The key insight is that precision should instead denote the refinement depth of one shared expert state. Based on this insight, we present PagedMoE, which stores each expert once using a prefix-compatible tree codebook and bitplane layout. Lower-precision representations are valid prefixes of higher-precision ones, allowing cached data to be reused or extended by fetching only missing bitplanes. PagedMoE selects the required prefix length before I/O using current routing weights and offline expert-specific error profiles, and directly executes cached 1-8-bit prefixes without materializing full-precision experts. > At an average routed-expert precision of 2.5 bits, PagedMoE achieves quality close to GPTQ-INT4 on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and to MXFP4 on most evaluated GLM5.2 tasks. With a 24 GiB expert cache, it reaches 8.89 tokens/s on Qwen3.5, 1.33x the throughput of the same dynamic requests using independent precision objects and 1.56x that of uniform 4-bit execution.
papers.summary: 把超大 MoE 模型的专家放在 SSD 上、内存只缓存最近用过的专家，就能在本地跑，但 SSD 读取仍然卡在关键路径上。按 token 动态决定每个专家用多少比特，本可以少读数据；可如果同一个专家的不同精度版本被当成互不相干的几份数据，缓存就无法复用，重叠的部分会被反复读取。PagedMoE 把精度看成同一份专家数据读到多深：低精度表示正好是高精度表示的前缀，缓存里已有低精度版本时，只需补读缺少的那几层比特。专家的每个权重平均只用 2.5 比特时，质量就接近常见的 4 比特量化；同样的动态请求下，吞吐是把各精度当独立数据时的 1.33 倍。

papers.title: Supermicro Launches KV Cache Solution with IBM and NVIDIA Demonstrating Significant Inference Performance Benefits
papers.abstract: SAN JOSE, Calif., Nov. 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Supermicro, Inc. (NASDAQ: SMCI), an AI, Enterprise, Storage, and 5G/Edge Total IT Solution Provider featuring Data Center Building Block Solutions® (DCBBS), today announced a new KV cache storage solution with IBM and NVIDIA. The joint solution integrates Supermicro Petascale all-flash storage servers using AMD EPYC 9005 Series processors ("Turin"), IBM Storage Scale software, along with NVIDIA Dynamo inference framework software and Spectrum-X Ethernet networking.   * Joint Solution Validation – Supermicro, IBM, and NVIDIA conducted extensive cluster-level testing to measure performance, including high concurrency and noisy-neighbor network traffic scenarios.   * Dramatically Faster and More Consistent Inference Performance – In joint testing Supermicro and NVIDIA, with a 120-billion-parameter LLM, persistent KV cache delivered up to 56x faster TTFT at 130,000-token prompts.^{[1]} As input length increased from 30,000 to 130,000 tokens, TTFT increased by only 0.377 seconds with KV cache, compared with 29.55 seconds without it, enabling more consistent performance for long-context workloads.
papers.summary: 长上下文推理的首 token 延迟，大头花在 prefill 上：每次都要为长 prompt 重新算一遍 KV cache。Supermicro 联合 IBM 和 NVIDIA 推出一套方案，把算好的 KV cache 持久存到全闪存存储集群上，下次直接读回，不再重算。厂商在一个大模型上测得，13 万 token 的 prompt 首 token 延迟最多快了 56 倍；而且输入越长，存缓存的好处越明显。这些是厂商自己的测试，没有独立复现，但它说明对反复用到的长上下文，从存储里读缓存可能比重算划算得多。

papers.title: Should You Split Decode? Disaggregation Across Future Models and Accelerators
papers.abstract: For large language model (LLM) inference, prefill/decode disaggregation (P/D) is deployed in production to isolate phases with different resource demands. Attention/feed-forward network disaggregation (AFD) splits decode again, but adds communication, placement constraints, and another provisioned pool. We ask whether role-specific placement repays this cost as models and accelerator roadmaps change. Infrastructure is committed before future models and hardware can be benchmarked. We present SiliconForge, a calibrated model that varies the serving decomposition and hardware assignment independently. We compare P/D and P/D+AFD across four model directions, four accelerator classes anchored to current and announced parts, and two fabrics. We co-optimize each design using the same rules for pipeline overlap and the same power budget. Our main comparisons show no robust deployment-level AFD advantage in service-level objective (SLO) goodput per kW. Most nominal estimates favor P/D. The largest AFD lead comes from fitting one more prefill replica, not from a more efficient decode pool. AFD has a nominal lead in the KV-heavy (key-value) model direction when the co-located expert pool spans several small scale-up domains. Larger domains or a fast fabric for both designs weaken that lead. We therefore find that prefill provisioning, decode memory bandwidth, links, and pool granularity decide deployments more than the split alone. A fixed hardware assignment can lose its advantage as models, fabrics, hardware assumptions, and objectives change. Re-optimizing mappings and pool sizes on the same hardware cuts early commitment's median normalized goodput loss from 36% to 9%. We recommend adjustable mappings and pool sizes to let boundary and hardware choices follow model demands.
papers.summary: 在已经分开部署 prefill 和 decode 的推理服务里，再把 decode 拆成注意力和前馈网络两个资源池，值不值？这篇论文的答案是多数情况下不值，硬件安排能不能随时调整更要紧。硬件得在未来的模型和芯片出来前买定，作者用一个校准过的性能模型，在相同功耗预算下比较两种方案：再拆 decode 没有稳健的优势，它最大的领先其实来自多放下一个 prefill 副本。所以别把映射定死，也就是哪个环节放哪类芯片、每个池子放多少台。硬件或模型条件一变，定死的部署方案在同样功耗下完成的请求量上，中位数要比当时最好的方案少 36%；在同一批硬件上重新调整，差距能降到 9%。
